lines.en: Imani, did you hear the speech? They had been dating for eight years before he finally proposed.
lines.pt: Imani, você ouviu o discurso? Eles namoravam havia oito anos antes de ele finalmente pedir em casamento.

lines.en: Eight years! I assumed they had been going out for only two or three. Nobody told me.
lines.pt: Oito anos! Achei que eles saíam juntos havia só dois ou três. Ninguém me contou.

lines.en: No, they had been living together for six years, and her parents had been asking when the wedding would be.
lines.pt: Não, moravam juntos havia seis anos, e os pais dela vinham perguntando quando seria o casamento.

lines.en: That must have been stressful. Had they been planning the big day for long?
lines.pt: Deve ter sido estressante. Eles vinham planejando o grande dia havia muito tempo?

lines.en: For about a year. The bride had been saving money, and the groom had been practising his speech every night.
lines.pt: Cerca de um ano. A noiva vinha economizando, e o noivo ensaiava o discurso toda noite.

lines.en: Well, he was good. He said they had been arguing about the music right up to the last week.
lines.pt: Bem, ele foi bom. Disse que vinham discutindo sobre a música até a última semana.

lines.en: That is typical! My cousin and her husband had been engaged for three years before they set a date.
lines.pt: Isso é típico! Minha prima e o marido estavam noivos havia três anos antes de marcarem uma data.

lines.en: And did it work out? Some couples had been together for ages and still decided to split up.
lines.pt: E deu certo? Alguns casais estavam juntos havia séculos e mesmo assim decidiram se separar.

lines.en: It did, and now they are very happy. Honestly, I had been worrying that they would never get married.
lines.pt: Deu, e agora são muito felizes. Sinceramente, eu vinha me preocupando que nunca se casariam.

lines.en: I am glad it ended well. Look, the band had been tuning up for ten minutes, and now the first dance is starting.
lines.pt: Que bom que acabou bem. Olhe, a banda vinha afinando os instrumentos havia dez minutos, e agora a primeira dança vai começar.

lines.en: Come on, let’s dance. We had been sitting for two hours, and my feet had been asking for this!
lines.pt: Vamos dançar. Estávamos sentados havia duas horas, e meus pés vinham pedindo por isso!

pages.title: A wedding by the harbour · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Saturday afternoon in Wellington. A wedding takes place in a hall near the harbour. The bride and groom have just cut the cake. Cleo and Max sit at a table. The speeches finish, and everyone claps. Cleo wants to talk about the story of the couple.

“Max, did you hear the speech? They had been dating for eight years before he finally proposed.” says Cleo. “Eight years! I assumed they had been going out for only two or three. Nobody told me.” says Max. “No, they had been living together for six years, and her parents had been asking when the wedding would be.” says Cleo.
